description: Scans a shell command for dangerous / destructive patterns before execution — rm -rf /, curl|sh remote-exec, dd/mkfs raw disk writes, fork bombs, chmod 777, privilege escalation, force-push to protected branches, kubectl/docker destroys, firewall/security disables, and data exfiltration. Quote- and substitution-aware (content inside quotes never triggers). Deterministic and offline — never executes the command. Returns PASS/FLAG/BLOCK with findings. Call before an agent runs any shell command.

command.description: The shell command line to scan.

blockSeverityAtOrAbove.description: Minimum severity that yields BLOCK (default: high).

name: scan_command
